articles.summary: Design systems are no longer ‘just’ about consistent UI and component libraries. They’re strategic capabilities that harness design intent, drive coherence and accelerate a team's ability to innovate.Here's how the Atlassian Design System (ADS) is evolving to be a full stack context engine to meet the demands of an AI-native future.
articles.title: Atlassian Design System: Building the context engine for the AI era
